products.name: Avoma
products.note: Meeting intelligence AI; conversation analytics; coaching; revenue team data

profile_text.body:
Avoma is a software company headquartered in Fremont, California that describes itself as offering an all-in-one AI platform covering note-taking, scheduling, and coaching for revenue and sales teams. Its site states that the platform is designed to automate note-taking, email follow-ups, CRM data entry, scheduling, lead qualification and routing, call scoring, and personalized coaching, with the company claiming users can save more than four hours per week through that automation.

The core product, also called Avoma, is tracked in the notes, knowledge, and meetings category and encompasses meeting intelligence, conversation analytics, coaching, and revenue team data capabilities. The site additionally describes an AI Copilot for answering questions from recorded conversations, as well as deal and churn risk alerts, sales methodology tracking, pipeline inspection, and win-loss analysis intended to support forecasting and quota attainment.

The held facts show Avoma has a verified presence in the site's registry as of August 2026 and carries a notable exposure count of 161 records associated with California, though no specific litigation cases are recorded in the data.
